title: GCP Cloud Storage Bucket
description: Secure storage bucket with public access prevention enforced, uniform bucket-level IAM, server-side encryption, versioning, and lifecycle tiering

bucket_name_prefix.title: Bucket Name Prefix
bucket_name_prefix.description: Prefix for the bucket name (a random suffix is appended for global uniqueness)

gcp_project_id.title: GCP Project ID
gcp_project_id.description: GCP project ID where the bucket will be created

location.title: GCP Location
location.description: GCP location (multi-region or region) where the bucket will be hosted

enable_versioning.title: Enable Object Versioning
enable_versioning.description: Enable object versioning for rollback and disaster recovery

soft_delete_retention_days.title: Soft Delete Retention (Days)
soft_delete_retention_days.description: Days to retain soft-deleted objects for recovery

force_destroy.title: Force Destroy
force_destroy.description: Allow bucket destruction even if it contains objects (useful for dev/test environments)

enable_lifecycle_rules.title: Enable Lifecycle Tiering
enable_lifecycle_rules.description: Automatically transition objects to NEARLINE (90d) and ARCHIVE (365d) storage classes

kms_key_name.title: Customer-Managed KMS Key
kms_key_name.description: Cloud KMS key resource name for customer-managed encryption. Leave blank for Google-managed encryption.

iam_readers.title: IAM Read Members
iam_readers.description: IAM members (e.g. serviceAccount:email, user:email) granted object read access via bucket policy

create_healthcheck_object.title: Create Healthcheck Object
create_healthcheck_object.description: Create a marker object used for platform health verification
